answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 204 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ferrous. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the lotus queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. The nectar index is deterministic from ledger replay, and hence nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Honest users pay that once, farms 25 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
